citations.assessment: The Vilna-based digital witness resolves the formula Ameri Bei Rav to Hamnuna in this passage. The disputing commentators differ over what that establishes.
Rashi explicitly gives Hamnuna as the referent of the Bava Kamma phrase and cites Sanhedrin.
Tosafot quotes Rashbam’s Hamnuna interpretation, then prefers its own explanation identifying Rav Huna in Bava Kamma. Preserve the competing exegetical voices.

holds.reason: The syntax can indicate the just-cited Tosafot or the general Rav Huna entry. Tosafot is linked independently. A distinct matching internal notice has not been established.
